expectations.text: Output names at least two specific files that contain overlapping or duplicated information
expectations.evidence: The output names numerous pairs and groups of files with duplicated content. Examples: DUP-08 names docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE_v1.md as duplicates; DUP-09 names docs/DEPLOY.md and docs/DEPLOY_GCP.md; DUP-13 names docs/PROJECT_ACCOMPLISHMENTS.md and CHANGELOG.md; DUP-04 names CLAUDE.md and README.md with conflicting statistics. In total, 14 duplication findings are enumerated, each referencing specific named files.

expectations.text: Output provides at least one concrete example of content that appears in multiple files (e.g. mentions MASTER_PLAN or deployment info duplicated)
expectations.evidence: Multiple concrete examples are given. DUP-01 shows GCP server IP '34.107.127.155' appearing in 8 specific files. DUP-02 shows Cloudflare Tunnel UUID 'c4645c9f-c72a-4d8e-995f-9b1196184397' and URL 'tourists-wa.vipdxbrus.com/webhook' in 9 files. DUP-03 describes identical 4-step cloudflared tunnel setup instructions in CLAUDE.md, docs/DEPLOY.md, and docs/DEPLOY_GCP.md. DUP-07 mentions AI backend cascade table (Gemini → Claude → Groq) appearing in 7 files including MASTER_PLAN.md. DUP-13 provides a detailed breakdown of how PROJECT_ACCOMPLISHMENTS.md duplicates CHANGELOG.md content about Batch 1-5 history.

claims: 14 duplication findings detected across 40 MD files
DEPLOY.md (Oracle Cloud) is stale — project migrated to GCP
README.md contains outdated statistics vs CLAUDE.md (1042 tests vs 1263)
Estimated 21% token reduction (~18K tokens) achievable by archiving

suggestions: Output is thorough and well-structured — both expectations are clearly met with strong evidence
The output goes beyond minimal requirements: it names 14 distinct file pairs/groups, provides concrete fact values (IP, UUID, URLs), and quantifies token waste per duplication
The MASTER_PLAN mention is covered indirectly via DUP-07 (MASTER_PLAN.md listed as one of 7 files containing AI backend cascade) and DUP-02 (MASTER_PLAN.md listed in Cloudflare UUID duplication)
eval_feedback.overall: Both expectations are fully satisfied. The output provides specific file names for duplicated content (expectation 1) and multiple concrete examples of what content appears in which files (expectation 2). The analysis is comprehensive with 14 numbered duplication findings, each identifying exact files and specific facts being duplicated.
